title: Ethyl 2,2-difluoro-2-(2-oxo-2H-chromen-3-yl) acetate inhibits the malignant biological behaviors of colorectal cancer by restricting the phosphorylation and nuclear translocation of STAT3.
authors: Lin, Jie; Liu, Weijing; Li, Xiaodan; Lin, Jiansuo; Fang, Xuehong; Liang, Yanwen; Zhang, Wen; Ren, Jianwei; Wang, Feng; Zou, Liyi; Liu, Yi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究香豆素衍生物C2F通过抑制STAT3磷酸化与核转位影响结直肠癌恶性行为，涉及STAT3-DNA核转位但非TF-DNA结合建模，方法以湿实验为主，仅含分子对接预测，与课题关联较弱。
abstract: To investigate the effect of a novel coumarin derivative, ethyl 2,2-difluoro-2 - (2-oxo-2H-chromen-3-yl) acetate (C2F), on the malignant biological behaviors of colorectal cancer (CRC) and elucidate its mechanism. In vitro, the effects of C2F on the proliferation, apoptosis, migration, invasion, and cell cycle of CRC cells were analyzed by MTT assay, EdU staining, colony formation assay, flow cytometry, wound healing and transwell assay. The anti-CRC activity of C2F was evaluated in a nude mice xenograft model in vivo. Western blot was conducted to detect the expression of protein in cells and mice tissue. Then, the potential targets of C2F in CRC were predicted by network pharmacology analysis and molecular docking. The localization of STAT3 was observed through immunofluorescence experiment. C2F inhibits CRC cell proliferation, promotes CRC cell apoptosis, hinders CRC cell migration and invasion, and prevents the cell cycle from entering the G2/M phase. In vivo, C2F inhibited tumor growth in xenograft model. C2F inhibited signal transduction and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) phosphorylation and blocked interleukin-6 (IL-6)-induced STAT3 nuclear translocation. C2F inhibits the malignant biological behavior of CRC by limiting STAT3 phosphorylation and entry into the nucleus.
abstract_zh: 为探讨新型香豆素衍生物2,2-二氟-2-(2-氧代-2H-色烯-3-基)乙酸乙酯（C2F）对结直肠癌（CRC）恶性生物学行为的影响并阐明其机制。体外实验中，通过MTT法、EdU染色、集落形成实验、流式细胞术、划痕愈合及transwell实验分析C2F对CRC细胞增殖、凋亡、迁移、侵袭及细胞周期的影响。在体内，通过裸鼠异种移植模型评估C2F的抗CRC活性。采用Western blot检测细胞及小鼠组织中蛋白的表达。随后，通过网络药理学分析和分子对接预测C2F在CRC中的潜在靶点。通过免疫荧光实验观察STAT3的定位。C2F抑制CRC细胞增殖，促进CRC细胞凋亡，阻碍CRC细胞迁移和侵袭，并阻止细胞周期进入G2/M期。在体内，C2F抑制异种移植模型中的肿瘤生长。C2F抑制信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）磷酸化，并阻断白细胞介素-6（IL-6）诱导的STAT3核转位。C2F通过限制STAT3磷酸化及进入细胞核来抑制CRC的恶性生物学行为。
